1. Register an NCDC source document

Upload a source you are authorised to use. PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown are supported; maximum 25 MB. Scanned PDFs may need OCR before text extraction works.

Registered curriculum documents

Remove unnecessary source files here. For safety, SASA allows deletion only when a document has no curriculum entries, topic records or generated questions referencing it. Existing curriculum entries, learning outcomes, topics and questions are never automatically deleted by this action.

3. Review imported curriculum entries

Newest imported entries appear first. By default, this view shows entries linked to the two most recently registered and verified NCDC documents. Searching by text, class, subject or review status automatically searches the full imported collection; you can also choose a specific document or all documents. Selection and bulk deletion apply to the entries currently displayed.
